persona: Mid-level DFT engineer on networking SoCs, strong on scan and MBIST, no boundary scan work
resumeText:
Harsha Vardhan Reddy | Hyderabad | harsha.reddy@example.com

EXPERIENCE
DFT Engineer, Deccan Silicon Works, Hyderabad (2021 - present)
- Performed scan insertion and EDT compression for a networking SoC using Tessent.
- Generated stuck-at and transition fault ATPG patterns and reported test coverage per block.
- Inserted MBIST controllers for on-chip SRAMs with Tessent MemoryBIST and debugged repair flows.
- Ran scan pattern simulation of serial and parallel scan patterns with SDF timing.
- Wrote SDC constraints for scan shift and capture modes and closed test-mode timing in PrimeTime.
- Wrote Tcl scripts to automate the DFT insertion flow across 12 blocks.
- Fixed DFT rule violations reported by Spyglass DFT on block RTL.

Junior Design Engineer, Kakatiya Chip Services, Hyderabad (2020 - 2021)
- Supported the DFT team with netlist checks and coverage reports.

SKILLS
Verilog, Digital electronics, Tessent, PrimeTime, Tcl, Linux

EDUCATION
BTech Electronics and Communication Engineering, JNTU Hyderabad, 2020
